data.headline: The SSC Selection Posts Examination assesses candidates for Group 'B' and 'C' positions in government departments. It involves stages like a computer-based test, skill test, and document verification  selection posts
The Combined Graduate Level (CGL) examination conducted by the Staff Selection Commission (SSC) in India is a multi-tier examination, and it covers a wide range of topics.
The Stenographer Grade 'C' and 'D' exams are competitive exams held to recruit stenographers for various government departments and ministries.
This competitive exam is held to recruit junior engineers in various government departments and organizations.
This is a competitive examination in India that is conducted to recruit candidates for various clerical and lower-division clerk positions in government ministries, departments, and organizations.
The Constable GD (General Duty) exam is conducted by various Indian paramilitary and police forces, including the BSF, CRPF, and CISF, to recruit candidates for frontline constable positions.

The Junior Hindi Translator exam by SSC (Staff Selection Commission) is a competitive examination in India for recruiting candidates to translate and assist in Hindi-English translation work in various government departments and organizations,
The SSC (Staff Selection Commission) conducts the Sub-Inspector (SI) in Delhi Police exam to recruit candidates for the position of Sub-Inspector in the Delhi Police department
Several other exams conducted by SSC to recruit candidates
SSC (Staff Selection Commission) conducts departmental exams for existing government employees seeking promotions or transfers within their respective departments.
